description: Points a subdomain (for example photos.yourstudio.com) at a creative studio's client pages on Focal. The CNAME target is the one Focal's hosting assigned to that domain; the TXT proof is only applied when Focal asks the owner to prove control of a domain someone else released.
variableDescription: target: the hostname the subdomain points to (Focal's hosting assigns it per domain); ownership: a one-time proof token (the record reads domain-verify=<token>)
